name: gcp
title: Google Cloud Secret Manager
description: Secrets in one Google Cloud project, under a name prefix. Read with this machine's gcloud sign-in (or a bound google connection); access is granted with the Secret Accessor role, limited to the prefix.

install.linux: sh -c 'curl -sS https://packages.cloud.google.com/apt/doc/apt-key.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg] https://packages.cloud.google.com/apt cloud-sdk main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google-cloud-sdk.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y google-cloud-cli'
